title: Let admins expire stale unpaid orders
description: Unpaid orders pile up. Adds /api/admin/orders/expire for the ops dashboard's "expire stale orders" link: it cancels pending orders older than 14 days and says how many. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: A GET request cancels orders. GETs should be safe: link prefetching, crawlers, retries and caches can trigger it, and because sessions also come from a cookie, any page an admin visits can fire it with an image tag (CSRF). Make it POST.
